requiredFindings.title: The publication's capped reread allowance is short of the read it performs
requiredFindings.failureScenario: capped_read allows 2*len+8192 bytes. read_bounded_accounted of an exact-length file charges the platform read_bounded_cost growth sum. Those bytes exceed the allowance for lengths 16384–20480 (by 4097 down to 1), 32768–53248 (by 20481 down to 1), 65536–118784 (by 53249 down to 1), and 131072 (by 118785). decode admits a capsule up to the 131072-byte parser cap before any effect, and publish's confirmation prepaid rereads that exact length after publish_private_file has renamed state.v1. The confirmation carve is one judged sample plus capped_read once the first sample and the reopen have been spent, and unused write allowance is not returned. The reread or the second sample then fails closed with ReservedPostcheck. publish returns the budget row and leaves the owner on the predecessor, while the pointer already names the new capsule. A larger outer ledger does not pay the shortfall. The same formula reserves an existing content-addressed record's reread. Required: reserve read_bounded_cost(len, attempts) for both rereads, using the read session's attempt bound (one edge per growth, the EOF read, and four spare attempts), so a lawful capsule completes when the ledger can pay that cost and a short ledger still fails before the first effect.

scope: X4T-a2 and X4T-b r1, law X4T r9 items 1, 2, 7, 8, 11 and 12, publication protocol for X4B r4 items 5 and 6. Inventory v106 ACCEPT on v105: 785 rows by value, two added. RF-1: capped_read is below read_bounded_accounted for lawful capsule lengths, and the confirmation fails closed after state.v1 is renamed. Replay: 39 security lib tests passed (12 floor publication, 19 current-trust admission, 7 accepted-store fixture, 1 gate advance). verify_scratch 71 inventory successors, 72 contract successors, 16 inheritance rows, v106 selected. verify_projection 16 rows, 83 corruptions refused. check_package_edges --lane host passed. Workspace suite and workspace clippy were not replayed.
